title: Deep Research System Card
paper_type_zh: 前沿智能体系统卡与浏览后训练数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要审计浏览智能体后训练、奖励/评分合约、安全数据与污染边界的读者
one_line: OpenAI's Deep Research System Card discloses browsing-task reinforcement learning with ground-truth or rubric grading by a chain-of-thought model and added browsing safety data, but not the datasets, trajectories, graders, reward design, or reproducibility artifacts.
OpenAI 的 Deep Research System Card 披露了浏览任务强化学习：以真值或量规为依据、由思维链模型评分，并加入浏览安全数据；但未披露数据集、轨迹、评分器、奖励设计或复现工件。
why: It is a direct Track 12 disclosure of an agentic browsing post-training interface: it identifies the high-level task and feedback contracts while making the missing provenance, reward, environment, and contamination evidence explicit.
inclusion_reason: A frontier system card that directly discloses browsing-task RL, answer/rubric grading by a chain-of-thought model, reused and browsing-specific safety datasets, and browser-contamination analysis while withholding the records and controls required to audit the data/reward pipeline.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Agentic browsing can be trained with tasks, feedback, tools, and safety mitigations that are only partially visible in a system card. The audit question is not whether Deep Research is a released browsing corpus or reproducible agent recipe, but which training and feedback interfaces OpenAI actually discloses and which controls remain unestablished.

The Deep Research System Card says OpenAI created browsing datasets for research use cases, trained an early web-browsing version of o3 with reinforcement learning on browsing tasks, and used ground-truth answers or rubrics graded by a chain-of-thought model. It also names reused o1 safety datasets and new browsing-specific safety data. The official sources do not release the tasks, web data, trajectories, graders, reward transformation, browser environment, or reproducibility artifacts.

智能体浏览可以依赖任务、反馈、工具和安全缓解措施进行训练，但系统卡对这些内容只作部分可见的说明。审计问题不是把 Deep Research 当作已发布的浏览语料或可复现智能体配方，而是识别 OpenAI 实际披露了哪些训练与反馈接口，以及哪些控制尚未确立。

Deep Research System Card称，OpenAI 为研究用例创建了浏览数据集，以浏览优化的早期 o3 版本在浏览任务上进行强化学习，并使用真值答案或量规、由思维链模型评分。它还提到了复用的 o1 安全数据集和新的浏览专用安全数据。官方来源没有发布任务、网页数据、轨迹、评分器、奖励转换、浏览环境或复现工件。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
This Card treats Deep Research as a partial disclosure ledger for agentic browsing post-training. The report supplies a high-level task-and-feedback interface: objective auto-gradable tasks with ground-truth answers, open-ended tasks with grading rubrics, model responses, and a chain-of-thought model used to grade those responses during browsing-task RL.

That interface is not a released record schema. The card does not provide browser observations or actions, search or click logs, web snapshots, Python inputs and outputs, report/citation fields, task provenance, grader prompts, or the reward representation. The report-level disclosure supports an answer-level feedback claim, while trace, environment, and reward details remain unknown.

本 Card 将 Deep Research 视为一份关于智能体浏览后训练的部分披露台账。报告提供了高层的任务—反馈接口：带真值答案的客观可自动评分任务、带评分量规的开放式任务、模型回复，以及在浏览任务 RL 中用于对回复评分的思维链模型。

这一接口不是已发布的记录模式。系统卡没有提供浏览器观察或动作、搜索或点击日志、网页快照、Python 输入与输出、报告/引用字段、任务溯源、评分器提示词或奖励表示。报告级披露支持回答级反馈主张，而轨迹、环境和奖励细节仍为 unknown。

title: Method
方法
html:
The official sources support four bounded layers of disclosure.

  1. Browsing tasks and learned behavior. OpenAI says new browsing datasets were created for research use cases and that the model learns searching, clicking, scrolling, file interpretation, sandboxed Python use, and synthesis across many websites. Task sources, prompts, web snapshots, browser states, action schemas, tool versions, and retained trajectories are unknown.
  2. Training feedback. The card says datasets span objective auto-gradable tasks with ground-truth answers and open-ended tasks with grading rubrics. During RL on browsing tasks, a chain-of-thought model grades responses against the ground truth or rubric. Reward scalarization, aggregation, model checkpoint and prompt, calibration, thresholds, error rates, and reward-hacking analysis are not disclosed.
  3. Safety additions and mitigations. The report names o1 safety datasets reused in training and new browsing-specific safety datasets. It also describes new prompt-injection safety training, system constraints on arbitrary URLs, refreshed personal-data policies, new safety data/evaluations, and a system blocklist. The records, policies, mixing, optimization use, and implementation are unknown.
  4. Environment and evaluation boundary. Deep Research can inspect web text, images, PDFs, user files, and run Python for calculations, analysis, and plotting. The Python tool has no internet access and runs in the GPT-4o sandbox. These deployment and evaluation facts do not establish a released browser/Python training environment, replayable container, or training-tool contract.

官方来源支持以下四层边界明确的披露。

  1. 浏览任务与习得行为。 OpenAI 称，为研究用例创建了新的浏览数据集，模型学习搜索、点击、滚动、文件解读、使用沙盒 Python，以及综合多个网站信息。任务来源、提示词、网页快照、浏览器状态、动作模式、工具版本和保留轨迹均为 unknown。
  2. 训练反馈。 系统卡称，数据集涵盖带真值答案的客观可自动评分任务，以及带评分量规的开放式任务。在浏览任务 RL 中，思维链模型根据真值或量规对回复评分。奖励标量化、聚合、模型检查点和提示词、校准、阈值、错误率与奖励投机分析均未披露。
  3. 安全补充与缓解措施。 报告提到复用于训练的 o1 安全数据集和新的浏览专用安全数据集；还描述了新的提示词注入安全训练、对任意 URL 的系统限制、更新的个人数据政策、新的安全数据/评估以及系统阻止列表。记录、政策、混合、优化用途和实现均为 unknown。
  4. 环境与评估边界。 Deep Research 可以检查网页文本、图像、PDF、用户文件，并运行 Python 进行计算、分析和绘图。Python 工具不能访问互联网，并在 GPT-4o 沙盒中运行。这些部署与评估事实并不能确立已发布的浏览/Python 训练环境、可回放容器或训练工具合约。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official system card dated February 25, 2025 directly supports the browsing-task RL, ground-truth/rubric grading, chain-of-thought grader, safety-data, prompt-injection mitigation, and sandbox statements in this Card. The official system-card page and launch announcement corroborate that this is an agentic web-research release, not an academic paper or data release.

The card reports safety, external red-team, and Preparedness evaluations. It also documents an evaluation-specific browsing-contamination analysis: some CTF browsing trajectories retrieved online hints or full flags, and reported performance declined after contaminated trajectories were removed. This is evidence of an evaluation risk and a specific filtering analysis; it is not evidence of a disclosed training-data decontamination procedure.

Reported evaluations and mitigations must remain separate from training evidence. They do not reveal the browser-task corpus, test/train allocation, rubrics, grader implementation, reward transformation, browsing harness, logs, or the provenance and rights of browsing or safety records.

日期为 2025 年 2 月 25 日的官方系统卡，直接支持本 Card 中关于浏览任务 RL、真值/量规评分、思维链评分器、安全数据、提示词注入缓解和沙盒的表述。官方系统卡页面和发布公告佐证该发布是智能体网页研究能力，而非学术论文或数据发布。

系统卡报告了安全、外部红队和 Preparedness 评估，还记录了专属于评估的浏览污染分析：一些 CTF 浏览轨迹检索到了在线提示或完整 flag，去除受污染轨迹后报告性能下降。这是有关评估风险和特定过滤分析的证据，而不是已披露的训练数据去污染程序。

报告的评估和缓解措施必须与训练证据分开。它们不揭示浏览任务语料、测试/训练分配、量规、评分器实现、奖励转换、浏览 harness、日志，或浏览与安全记录的溯源和权利。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For this atlas, the contribution is not an open browsing dataset or agent framework. Its value is a relatively direct frontier disclosure of the high-level post-training interface: browsing tasks, objective answers or rubrics, chain-of-thought grading during RL, and browsing-specific safety data.

The system card also makes an unusually concrete audit distinction around browsing contamination in CTF evaluation. Together, these statements allow the ledger to separate a named task-and-feedback contract from the undisclosed records, grader, reward, environment, and reproduction controls. It must not be read as a release of an RL trajectory dataset or a fully specified RLVR recipe.

对本 atlas 而言，其贡献不是开放的浏览数据集或智能体框架，而是对高层后训练接口相对直接的前沿披露：浏览任务、客观答案或量规、RL 期间的思维链评分，以及浏览专用安全数据。

系统卡还围绕 CTF 评估中的浏览污染作出了异常具体的审计区分。这些陈述共同使台账能够将被命名的任务—反馈合约，与尚未披露的记录、评分器、奖励、环境和复现控制区分开来。它不得被解读为 RL 轨迹数据集或完全指定的 RLVR 配方发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• New browsing datasets, reused o1 safety datasets, and new browsing-specific safety datasets are named without task identities, source manifests, counts, rights, revisions, splits, or item-level lineage.
  • The disclosed ground-truth/rubric grading interface omits the chain-of-thought grader identity, prompt, version, calibration, thresholds, reward transformation, error rates, and reward-hacking analysis.
  • No browser observations/actions, search/click logs, web snapshots, Python inputs/outputs, tool schemas, sandbox or container versions, resets, replay artifacts, or rollout budgets are released.
  • Prompt-injection, privacy, red-team, and Preparedness evaluations document safety risk and mitigation, but their records and their relationship to training remain undisclosed.
  • The CTF contamination analysis is evaluation-specific; it does not establish training-data decontamination, benchmark-overlap controls, or reproducible evaluation logs.

• 新的浏览数据集、复用的 o1 安全数据集和新的浏览专用安全数据集虽被命名，但没有任务身份、来源清单、数量、权利、版本、划分或记录级谱系。
  • 已披露的真值/量规评分接口未说明思维链评分器的身份、提示词、版本、校准、阈值、奖励转换、错误率或奖励投机分析。
  • 没有发布浏览器观察/动作、搜索/点击日志、网页快照、Python 输入/输出、工具模式、沙盒或容器版本、重置、回放工件或 rollout 预算。
  • 提示词注入、隐私、红队和 Preparedness 评估记录了安全风险与缓解措施，但其记录及其与训练的关系仍未披露。
  • CTF 污染分析仅适用于评估；它不能确立训练数据去污染、基准重叠控制或可复现评估日志。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card to audit a concrete browsing-agent feedback boundary: which task and answer/rubric grading elements are officially named, which safety data and mitigation classes are named, and which records and controls are still unknown. It is useful for comparing frontier system-card disclosures without conflating a system's public browsing behavior with its private training data.

The Card supports Track 12 work on post-training feedback, web-browsing environments, contamination, and safety disclosure. It is not appropriate for direct reuse of data, trajectories, graders, or an RL recipe, because none of those artifacts are released or specified sufficiently for audit.

可使用本 Card 审计具体的浏览智能体反馈边界：哪些任务与答案/量规评分元素被官方命名，哪些安全数据和缓解类别被命名，以及哪些记录与控制仍为 unknown。它有助于比较前沿系统卡披露，而不会把系统公开的浏览行为与其私有训练数据混为一谈。

本 Card 支持 Track 12 关于后训练反馈、网页浏览环境、污染与安全披露的研究。它不适合直接复用数据、轨迹、评分器或 RL 配方，因为这些工件均未发布，或未被充分指定以供审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the training section first: it contains the bounded browsing-task RL and ground-truth/rubric chain-of-thought grading disclosure.
  • Keep training feedback separate from red-team, Preparedness, and other safety-evaluation records; the report does not establish that those evaluation items were optimized against.
  • Treat the CTF browsing-contamination discussion as evaluation-specific evidence, not as proof of training-data decontamination.
  • Record browser tasks, trajectories, grader implementation, reward transformation, web snapshots, tool contracts, and reproduction controls as unknown rather than filling them from deployment behavior.

• 先阅读训练部分；其中包含边界明确的浏览任务 RL 与真值/量规思维链评分披露。
  • 将训练反馈与红队、Preparedness 和其他安全评估记录分开；报告并未确立这些评估条目被用于优化。
  • 将 CTF 浏览污染讨论视为评估专用证据，而不是训练数据去污染的证明。
  • 将浏览任务、轨迹、评分器实现、奖励转换、网页快照、工具合约和复现控制记为 unknown，而不是从部署行为中补全。
